toxicity.Notes: Acute oral toxicity following OECD TG 420 with minor modifications: sixteen young BALB/c mice, eight of each sex and 22 +/- 5 g, starved overnight and randomised into a control group of four, which received 0.5 % carboxymethyl cellulose at 10 mL/kg, and three test groups of four given 2000, 200 and 120 mg/kg of the complex by oral gavage, then watched for three days. The result section states only that the LD50 dose of the vanadium-quercetin complex was found at 120 mg/kg body weight, which is the number recorded; no mortality counts per dose and no calculation are reported, so survival_pct stays empty. A separate 28-day repeated oral dose study in sixty BALB/c mice at 90, 45 and 20 mg/kg found histopathological damage to kidney, liver, stomach and testis at 90 mg/kg and none at 45 and 20 mg/kg; that is organ histology and belongs to the separate Organ toxicity pass. The anticancer work is a DMBA-induced rat mammary carcinogenesis model with no tumour volume, weight or incidence endpoint, so there is no main row.
